page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no margin notes. Page number and running head at the top; a catchword-like signature mark at the lower right.

main_text.p: Galat. 5. v. 5.6. Nos enim Spiritu ex fide spem iustitiæ expectamus. Nam in Christo Iesu neque circuncifio quicquam valet, neque præputium, sed fides per charitatem agens. Item v. 22.23.24.25. At fructus Spiritus, est charitas, gaudiū, pax, lenitas, benignitas, bonitas, fides, mansuetudo, temperantia. Aduersus eos qui sunt eiusmodi, non est Lex. Qui enim sunt Christi, carnem crucifixerunt cum affectibus & concupiscentijs. Si viuimus spiritu, spiritu etiam incedamus.

1. Pet. 3. v. 1.2. Similiter vxores subiecte sint suis viris: vt etiam si qui nō obediunt sermoni, per vxorum conuersationem absque sermone lucrifiant: Vbi spectarint cum reuerentia coniunctam castam conuersationem vestram.
Matth. 5. v. 16. Ita splendeat lux vestra coram hominibus, vt videant vestra bona opera, glorificentque Patrem vestrum qui est in cœlis.
Rom. 14. v. 19. Nempe igitur quæ ad pacem faciunt sectemur; & quę ad mutuam ædificationem.

page.notes: Marginal reference "d" before "1. Pet." is a section mark. The signature at lower right is partly illegible and read as approximate. Some words are blurred in the scan (e.g. "subiecte"); "spectarint" is uncertain and should be checked against the scan.
